symbols.gmalloc.label: Disagrees with ZCode seed. FMemory::Malloc and FMemory::Free both load GMalloc from the generated value (symbols.gmalloc_effective_ptr); the oracle's seed is the base-allocator singleton pointer, which the generator also derives, as symbols.gmalloc_base_slot, via the lazy-create function. Not tuned to either; the console test decides.
symbols.gmalloc.runtime: Disagrees with ZCode seed (see symbols.gmalloc.label); symbols.gmalloc_base_slot.runtime equals the seed.
structs.FUObjectArray.UObjectCreateListe: Disagrees with the staged ini (UE4SS 5.06 template defaults, Windows-sized mutexes). In this image the notify loop in the object-allocation member reads the TArray at this offset (data +0x0, Num +0x8).
structs.FUObjectArray.UObjectDeleteListe: Disagrees with the staged ini; the delete-listener add/notify members read the TArray at this offset under a mutex that starts 0x10 later.
structs.FUObjectArray.PrimarySerialNumbe: Disagrees with the staged ini; derived as the int32 before bShouldRecycleObjectIndices (medium: not touched by the member functions).
structs.FUObjectArray.bShouldRecycleObje: Disagrees with the staged ini; the free-index member tests this byte (cmp byte [this+X],1) before pushing the index on the free list.
structs.FUObjectArray.UEP_TotalSize: Disagrees with the staged ini; the next global in BSS (a different object) starts exactly here, and the structure ends one byte after bShouldRecycleObjectIndices rounded to 8.
structs.FNameEntry.header: Partial: the generator measures only the length shift of the entry header; the wide bit and probe-hash bits are not asserted.
emit.MemberVariableLayout.sha256: Follows from the five FUObjectArray fields above; with those set to the template values the file is byte-identical to the staged one (same size, same layout).
